subject: Rotating demo slot escrow & calendar handoffs for Helio Systems
messages:
From: Simon Blake <simon.blake@heliosys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@heliosys.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: initial outreach - demo and procurement alignment

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're ready to move from discovery to a technical demo and need to align several stakeholders: my platform team (me + 1 engineer), procurement (Priya), and our security reviewer. We operate across US, EU and APAC — finding a single slot that works for everyone is tough.

Can you propose a schedule that: 1) minimizes late-night calls for our engineers, 2) provides a rotating cadence so different Helio teams can attend, and 3) includes a short procurement/terms checkpoint? Ideally we keep the first meeting to ~60 minutes (45 demo + 15 Q&A).

Also, we need a SOC2 checklist and a draft SOW for procurement to review.

-Simon
Simon Blake
Senior Platform Engineer, Helio Systems

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Blake <simon.blake@heliosys.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@heliosys.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 18:03:00 +0200
Subject: Rotating demo slot escrow & calendar handoffs for Helio Systems

Hi Simon — great context, thanks.

We can run a rotating demo roster that balances across your regions. Proposed approach (pick one and we'll lock calendar invites):

Option A — US-friendly (late EU, early APAC)
- Tue 2027-06-08 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 02:00 AEST (next day)
- Recurrence: biweekly, Redwood AE/SE rotate on-call for follow-ups

Option B — EU overlap (best cross-region compromise)
- Wed 2027-06-09 14:00 UTC / 07:00 PT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 AEST
- Recurrence: biweekly, every other session scheduled at time-shift +8 hours to favor APAC once/month

Option C — APAC-friendly (early EU, evening US)
- Thu 2027-06-10 02:00 UTC / 19:00 PT (previous day) / 04:00 CET / 11:00 AEST
- Recurrence: monthly rotation with a weekday that keeps APAC working hours available

Run-of-show (suggested): 0-5 min intro, 5-50 demo walkthrough (key integrations, perf & routing), 50-60 min Q&A + procurement/next steps.

Attached: SOC2-questionnaire.pdf (redacted answers), and I'll attach a draft SOW for Priya to review. If you confirm Option B, we'll create a recurring calendar series and an internal rotation roster for AE/SE handoffs so no individual takes repeated late calls.

Thoughts? If you want, I can also create an "escrowed slots" calendar with pre-reserved times that we only activate once procurement signs off — avoids last-minute rebooking.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Simon Blake <simon.blake@heliosys.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 18:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Rotating demo slot escrow & calendar handoffs for Helio Systems

+1 on Vanessa's plan. Quick operational notes from SE side: 
- We'll pack the demo for 45 minutes: 25 minutes ops/runtime + 20 minutes integration/embedding examples.
- Please have an engineer who owns infra/networking on the call for the troubleshooting portion.
- I'll prepare a short diagram of routing/fallbacks and a one-pager on latency expectations for the three deployment modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).

I'll volunteer for the first two sessions (Option B) and then hand off to Aditya for the following two. Vanessa — if you create the escrowed calendar, add an internal note on handoff date/time.

Diego Fernandez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Simon Blake <simon.blake@heliosys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@heliosys.com>, procurement@heliosys.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 00:15:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Rotating demo slot escrow & calendar handoffs for Helio Systems

Thanks Vanessa / Diego — Option B works best for the cross-functional folks here. Two quick asks:
1) We prefer biweekly cadence but would like a guarantee that at least one session each month is scheduled at APAC-friendly times (as you proposed).
2) Priya: can you review the draft SOW and confirm if procurement needs any changes before DocuSign?

Priya Kumar (procurement) <priya.kumar@heliosys.com> — adding you here. Please advise on timelines for contract review.

Simon

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Blake <simon.blake@heliosys.com>, Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@heliosys.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 01:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Rotating demo slot escrow & calendar handoffs for Helio Systems

Great — confirming Option B, biweekly with monthly APAC-friendly rotations. Action items: 
- Vanessa (AE): I'll create the "Helio — Escrowed Demo Slots" calendar and send a recurring invite for the first three dates (2027-06-09 14:00 UTC; 2027-06-23 14:00 UTC; 2027-07-07 14:00 UTC) and mark the session on 2027-07-21 as an APAC-shifted meeting (times TBC).
- Diego (SE): prepared run-of-show and performance one-pager for the first session.
- Priya (Procurement): we've attached the draft SOW (SOW-Helio-v2.docx). If this looks ok, we'll send via DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/HL-4721

Attachments: SOW-Helio-v2.docx (draft) — note: pricing is placeholder subject to final scope.

If anyone needs different times in the invite, reply-all with your available offsets and we can adjust before finalizing.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the first session.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
